with room_scope as (
), active_seat_stats as ( select count(s.seat_id) as active_seat_count, coalesce(sum(floor(time_to_sec(timediff(rs.close_time, rs.open_time)) / 60)) * (timestampdiff(day, date(#{beginTime}), date(#{endTime})) + 1), 0) as available_minutes from room_scope rs inner join seatflow_seat s on s.room_id = rs.room_id and s.status = 'enabled' ), reservation_stats as ( select count(r.reservation_id) as reservation_count from seatflow_reservation r inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where ), no_show_stats as ( select count(r.reservation_id) as no_show_count from seatflow_reservation r inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where r.start_time < #{endTime} and r.end_time > #{beginTime} and r.status = 'no_show' ), checkin_stats as ( select count(distinct c.checkin_id) as checkin_count from seatflow_checkin_record c inner join seatflow_reservation r on r.reservation_id = c.reservation_id inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where c.status = 'active' and r.start_time < #{endTime} and r.end_time > #{beginTime} ), usage_stats as ( select coalesce(sum(greatest(0, timestampdiff(minute, greatest(r.start_time, #{beginTime}), least(r.end_time, #{endTime}) ))), 0) as usage_minutes from seatflow_reservation r inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where ) select coalesce(rs.reservation_count, 0) as reservation_count, coalesce(cs.checkin_count, 0) as checkin_count, coalesce(ns.no_show_count, 0) as no_show_count, coalesce(ass.active_seat_count, 0) as active_seat_count, coalesce(us.usage_minutes, 0) as usage_minutes, case when coalesce(ass.available_minutes, 0) = 0 then 0 else round(coalesce(us.usage_minutes, 0) / ass.available_minutes, 4) end as usage_rate from reservation_stats rs cross join checkin_stats cs cross join no_show_stats ns cross join active_seat_stats ass cross join usage_stats us

with room_scope as (
) select s.seat_id, s.room_id, rs.room_name, s.seat_no, s.row_num, s.col_num, coalesce(count(distinct case when r.status in ('pending_checkin', 'in_use', 'completed') then r.reservation_id end), 0) as reservation_count, coalesce(sum(case when r.status in ('in_use', 'completed') then greatest(0, timestampdiff(minute, greatest(r.start_time, #{beginTime}), least(r.end_time, #{endTime}))) else 0 end), 0) as usage_minutes from seatflow_seat s inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = s.room_id left join seatflow_reservation r on r.seat_id = s.seat_id and r.start_time < #{endTime} and r.end_time > #{beginTime} and r.status in ('pending_checkin', 'in_use', 'completed') where s.status = 'enabled' group by s.seat_id, s.room_id, rs.room_name, s.seat_no, s.row_num, s.col_num
order by usage_minutes desc, s.room_id asc, s.row_num asc, s.col_num asc
order by reservation_count desc, s.room_id asc, s.row_num asc, s.col_num asc

with room_scope as (
), room_available as ( select rs.room_id, rs.room_name, count(s.seat_id) * floor(time_to_sec(timediff(rs.close_time, rs.open_time)) / 60) as available_minutes from room_scope rs inner join seatflow_seat s on s.room_id = rs.room_id and s.status = 'enabled' group by rs.room_id, rs.room_name, rs.open_time, rs.close_time ), room_usage as ( select date_format(date(r.start_time), '%Y-%m-%d') as report_date, r.room_id, coalesce(sum(greatest(0, timestampdiff(minute, greatest(r.start_time, #{beginTime}), least(r.end_time, #{endTime}) ))), 0) as usage_minutes from seatflow_reservation r inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where group by date(r.start_time), r.room_id ) select ru.report_date, ra.room_id, ra.room_name, coalesce(ru.usage_minutes, 0) as usage_minutes, coalesce(ra.available_minutes, 0) as available_minutes, case when coalesce(ra.available_minutes, 0) = 0 then 0 else round(coalesce(ru.usage_minutes, 0) / ra.available_minutes, 4) end as usage_rate from room_usage ru inner join room_available ra on ra.room_id = ru.room_id order by ru.report_date asc, ra.room_id asc

with room_scope as (
), reservation_slots as ( select date_format(r.start_time, '%H:00') as slot_label, count(r.reservation_id) as reservation_count from seatflow_reservation r inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where group by date_format(r.start_time, '%H:00') ), checkin_slots as ( select date_format(r.start_time, '%H:00') as slot_label, count(distinct c.checkin_id) as checkin_count from seatflow_checkin_record c inner join seatflow_reservation r on r.reservation_id = c.reservation_id inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where c.status = 'active' and r.start_time < #{endTime} and r.end_time > #{beginTime} group by date_format(r.start_time, '%H:00') ) select rs.slot_label, coalesce(rs.reservation_count, 0) as reservation_count, coalesce(cs.checkin_count, 0) as checkin_count from reservation_slots rs left join checkin_slots cs on cs.slot_label = rs.slot_label order by reservation_count desc, rs.slot_label asc

with room_scope as (
), room_available as ( select rs.room_id, rs.room_name, count(s.seat_id) * floor(time_to_sec(timediff(rs.close_time, rs.open_time)) / 60) * (timestampdiff(day, date(#{beginTime}), date(#{endTime})) + 1) as available_minutes from room_scope rs inner join seatflow_seat s on s.room_id = rs.room_id and s.status = 'enabled' group by rs.room_id, rs.room_name, rs.open_time, rs.close_time ), reservation_stats as ( select r.room_id, count(r.reservation_id) as reservation_count from seatflow_reservation r inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where group by r.room_id ), checkin_stats as ( select r.room_id, count(distinct c.checkin_id) as checkin_count from seatflow_checkin_record c inner join seatflow_reservation r on r.reservation_id = c.reservation_id inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where c.status = 'active' and r.start_time < #{endTime} and r.end_time > #{beginTime} group by r.room_id ), usage_stats as ( select r.room_id, coalesce(sum(greatest(0, timestampdiff(minute, greatest(r.start_time, #{beginTime}), least(r.end_time, #{endTime}) ))), 0) as usage_minutes from seatflow_reservation r inner join room_scope rs on rs.room_id = r.room_id where group by r.room_id ) select ra.room_id, ra.room_name, coalesce(rs.reservation_count, 0) as reservation_count, coalesce(cs.checkin_count, 0) as checkin_count, coalesce(us.usage_minutes, 0) as usage_minutes, case when coalesce(ra.available_minutes, 0) = 0 then 0 else round(coalesce(us.usage_minutes, 0) / ra.available_minutes, 4) end as usage_rate from room_available ra left join reservation_stats rs on rs.room_id = ra.room_id left join checkin_stats cs on cs.room_id = ra.room_id left join usage_stats us on us.room_id = ra.room_id
order by checkin_count desc, ra.room_id asc
order by usage_rate desc, ra.room_id asc
order by reservation_count desc, ra.room_id asc
